Maybank Global Sustainable Technology Fund (MYR Class)

The Maybank Global Sustainable Technology Fund - MYR Class (“MGSTMYR” or “the Fund”) is an equity fund that seeks to achieve capital appreciation by investing primarily in a portfolio of global technology-related equities.

Note: There is no guarantee that the Fund’s investment objective will be achieved and your capital may be at risk. Any material changes to the investment objective of the Fund would require Unit Holders’ approval.
